discord.invite: https://discord.gg/xgfKc5pVxG (permanent: the invite API returns expires_at null; it lands on the #updates announcement channel, type 5). Server name: Void Engine. Evidence: live GET of the invite API on 2026-09-28; scripts/community.cjs INVITE_URL on origin/main.
discord.liveCounts: ENDPOINT: GET https://discord.com/api/v10/invites/xgfKc5pVxG?with_counts=true. It needs no auth. Verified 2026-09-28 with Origin https://nateecho32-stack.github.io: HTTP 200, and the response echoes access-control-allow-origin for that origin, so the static site can fetch() it directly. Useful fields: approximate_member_count (100 on 2026-09-28), approximate_presence_count (41 online), guild.name ('Void Engine'), guild.icon (hash b0f0469a2afa63697a1d0001cb800083). Build the icon from the response, not hard-coded, because the hash changes when the icon changes: https://cdn.discordapp.com/icons/1345380333302059129/<guild.icon>.png?size=128 (200 image/png). The response also has channel.name 'updates', guild.features (COMMUNITY, NEWS, SOUNDBOARD), profile.member_count/online_count and 3 boosts. GUILD WIDGET IS OFF: https://discord.com/api/guilds/1345380333302059129/widget.json answers 403 {"message":"Widget Disabled","code":50004}, so no widget iframe and no online-member list. WHAT THE CURRENT SITE DOES: nothing with Discord's API. There are no matches for with_counts, approximate_ or discord.com/api in C:\wt\site assets/*.js or any .html. The only fetches are in assets/site.js: fetchLatestRelease (api.github.com/repos/nateecho32-stack/mefi-studio/releases/latest) and fetchRepo (repo facts; community.html uses has_discussions to switch the Discussions card and note). Discord appears only as plain invite links. RECOMMENDED USE: one fetch per page load; keep the result in sessionStorage for about 10 minutes (wrapped in try/catch); show the counts as approximate ('about 100 members · 41 online'); on any error or 429, fall back to a static 'Join the Void Engine Discord' button with no numbers. Never poll in a loop.
whatHappensThere: Sharing what you build with Studio, swapping model setups and listening together. This is the server's own pitch as the in-app join card words it: "Share what you're building, swap model setups, and listen together with other builders." (docs/community.md §1 The weekly card; docs/architecture.md › Community). Unfinished work and first-timers are explicitly welcome (site community.html and wiki/pages/community.md; README.md › Community).

Release announcements: each new Studio build is posted once in the server with a few highlights, the zip's download link and size, and the release link. A build is a published GitHub release with a vX.Y.Z tag and an uploaded .zip. Commits are never announced, pre-releases are posted quietly, and it polls hourly. The invite lands on #updates. (Void Engine Bot src/releases.mjs header; README 'Features by phase', Phase 2)

Showcase: /showcase title url description [public] [co_credit] posts your project to #showcase with a short AI-written blurb and tags, and nobody is pinged. You can co-credit someone who helped. It is the existing base for the owner's project-sharing idea. (src/commands/showcase.mjs)
Cowork sessions: /cowork start <topic> opens a temporary voice channel plus a thread to work alongside each other. Both go away 5 minutes after the voice channel empties. (src/commands/cowork.mjs)

Help threads: the asker can 'Mark as solution' on the reply that solved it, which gives the helper points and counts toward the Helper and Mentor roles. /ask answers questions from the Mefi Studio wiki. (src/commands/solution.mjs, src/commands/ask.mjs)

Participation roles that reward taking part and never invites or message counts. Member comes on join. Regular needs 4 active weeks in a row. Builder, Helper and Mentor need a moderator's approval. Spotlight is the project of the week, for 7 days. Cowork Host, Room Host, Patron and Contributor are granted. /me shows your points and streak privately, and there is no public leaderboard. (Void Engine Bot docs/roles.md)

Rooms (rolling out): private threads in #rooms that are also usable inside Studio (Friends › Rooms). You can ask to join or be invited, and the room owner approves. A hangout room holds up to 25 people and a cowork room up to 10. Void Engine moderators can read all rooms. (bot README Phase 3; bot docs/privacy.md; app renderer/rooms.js 'Hangout (up to 25)'/'Cowork (up to 10)'; CHANGELOG Unreleased 'Every room now says that Void Engine moderators can read it')

Listen together and /nowplaying (rolling out): one shared player per room, and a public card showing what a member's Studio is playing when they opt in. Both are kept in memory only. (bot README Phase 3; docs/community.md 'What comes later' Phase 3)

Coming to the bot (being written now, uncommitted): a welcome for newcomers, opt-in celebrations, /trivia, a daily prompt, model-drop posts, /help and an @mention chat persona. See bot.publicFeatures for detail.

inApp.feature: Void Engine join card
inApp.what: A small card invites people who are not in the server to join. It stays away for the first 3 days, then shows at most weekly, and monthly after four showings. It offers Join the Discord, Not now and Don't show again, and it promises no unlock. Community at the foot of the menu opens Settings › Community.
inApp.evidence: docs/community.md §1 'The weekly card'; CHANGELOG [0.3.3] 'The weekly card'; [0.4.4] 'The Void collection is free… Linking Discord is still optional and only joins you to the community'

inApp.feature: Link my Discord (Settings › Community)
inApp.what: An optional sign-in with Discord. Studio reads only who you are and whether you are in the Void Engine server, including your roles there. It re-checks weekly, Check now re-checks on demand, and Unlink revokes the grant and deletes the token. The code has shipped since 0.3.3. It has no effect yet because no build carries the 'Mefi Studio Link' app id: CLIENT_ID is "" in scripts/community.cjs in both v0.4.4 and main.

inApp.feature: Connection details (link app ID + rooms hub address)
inApp.what: Each PC can paste the link app ID and the rooms hub's address once, in Settings › Community › Connection details. They apply at once with no restart, and Save says whether the hub answered. This is how people will turn on Discord linking, Rooms, Friends and Listen together until a release has the addresses built in.
inApp.evidence: CHANGELOG [Unreleased] 'Discord linking and Rooms without environment variables'; commit 6b633be 'Link Discord and reach the rooms hub without environment variables'; docs/friends-setup.md §3

inApp.feature: Every theme and node style is free (Void collection)
inApp.what: The four two-tone themes (Void, Eclipse, Abyss, Neon Dusk) and three node styles (Singularity, Prism, Sigil) are free in Appearance for everyone. They were once a Discord-member perk (0.3.3); nothing is locked behind Discord any more.
inApp.evidence: CHANGELOG [0.4.4] first bullet; docs/community.md 'Nothing is locked behind the link'

inApp.feature: Links player: play and share links
inApp.what: Paste or drop a YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud or Vimeo link, or a plain audio/video file link (Discord attachments included), and it plays inside Studio. Copy link makes it easy to share in Discord.
inApp.evidence: CHANGELOG [0.4.0] '**Links** replaces the Spotify tab'

inApp.feature: Listen together
inApp.what: Pick one of your Void Engine rooms and play a link for it. Friends press Listen along and join at the same point, and the room's Discord thread gets a note. Whoever put it on, or the room owner, can pause, restart or stop it. Built since 0.4.0, but it needs the rooms hub, and HUB_URL is "" in scripts/hub-client.cjs, plus a linked Discord account.
inApp.evidence: CHANGELOG [0.4.0] 'Listen together' and 'Both need the rooms hub's address'; renderer/together.js; origin/main:scripts/hub-client.cjs line 39 HUB_URL = ""

inApp.feature: Share what I'm playing → /nowplaying (today's 'music taste' share)
inApp.what: Off by default, in Settings › Audio › Links. When on, Void Engine members can see your current link, station or just 'Local music' with /nowplaying in Discord. It never shows a file name, and the hub keeps it in memory only, dropping it when Studio closes. This is the only music sharing that exists today. A profile 'share music taste' switch and a most-played mixes chart are planned (see below).
inApp.evidence: CHANGELOG [0.4.0] 'Share what I'm playing'; renderer/together.js hint text; Void Engine Bot src/commands/nowplaying.mjs header

inApp.feature: Friends › Rooms
inApp.status: coming-0.4.5 (then needs the rooms hub: rolling-out)
inApp.what: The Void Engine rooms inside Studio. You can browse your rooms and listed ones, ask to join with a note, and accept or decline invites. Owners can let people in, invite by name, lock, close or delete rooms, and make new ones: hangout (up to 25) or cowork (up to 10), open to requests or invite-only, listed or not. Each room has a plain-text chat with @names, where links are never clickable, and messages can be reported. Invites waiting for you badge the Friends bubble. Each room states that Void Engine moderators can read it. Actions that can't be undone ask twice.

inApp.evidence: CHANGELOG [0.4.4] '### Added' 'Multi-PC sync'; docs/releases/0.4.4.md 'Keep every PC in step'

inApp.feature: Your PCs upgrades (Set up this PC, Keep this PC up to date, rebase, badge, ask before close)
inApp.what: This bundles several additions. Put my commits on top of GitHub's. The Friends bubble badges work that only this PC holds. Closing Studio asks first when such work exists. Keep this PC up to date (on by default) pulls other PCs' pushes within about a minute. Set up this PC checks Git, the GitHub CLI, Node.js, a GitHub sign-in, the Discord link and the rooms hub, with a button for each gap. Get a project from GitHub clones one of your repositories.
inApp.evidence: CHANGELOG [Unreleased] 'Multi-PC sync holds up better', 'Keep this PC up to date', 'Set up this PC' (two bullets); README.md 'Working from several PCs'

inApp.feature: Share between my PCs (sealed vault)
inApp.what: One private GitHub repository, <you>/mefi-studio-vault, carries what you tick between your own PCs, sealed with AES-256-GCM under a key only your paired PCs hold. Shelves: model results, learned decisions, team setups, brains, Playbook recipes, Claude Code memory notes, preferences, and open tasks and ideas. Every item is checked on the way out and again on the way in. Keys need a typed confirmation plus a Windows prompt.
inApp.evidence: CHANGELOG [Unreleased] 'Share between my PCs' (three bullets); commits d516312, 64dd009, 51c69b7; README.md 'Share between my PCs'

inApp.feature: Share with friends (.mefishare files)
inApp.what: Save one brain, recipe, team setup, set of model results, memory note or preferences to a .mefishare file and send it however you like. Studio scrubs paths, names, emails and the repo name, refuses secrets and shows you the contents first. A friend's file is reviewed before it reaches your library. A risky file is kept out, and a friend's file can never change your permissions.
inApp.evidence: CHANGELOG [Unreleased] 'Share with friends', 'A share the review cannot read to the end is blocked', 'A friend's preferences cannot change your permissions'; README.md 'Share with friends'

policy: No invite or referral rewards, and no rewards for joining. Discord's Platform Manipulation policy bans invite rewards, so credits, cosmetics, roles or perks must never be earned by inviting people or by joining the server. Studio's own rule: 'Nothing rewards inviting people: joining only moves the card's schedule' (docs/community.md, end of 'What comes later').
